class Torsor (P I : Type) extends Add I, Sub I, HMul Int I I, Neg I, HSMul I P P, HDiv P P I where
  zero : I
  add_zero (i : I) : i + zero = i
  add_comm (i j : I) : i + j = j + i
  add_assoc (i j k : I) : (i + j) + k = i + (j + k)
  add_left_neg (i : I) : (-i) + i = zero
  add_right_neg (i : I) : i + (-i) = zero := by
    rw [add_comm]
  sub_neg (i j : I) : i - (-j) = i + j
  sub_eq_add_neg (i j : I) : i - j = i + -j
  neg_neg (i : I) : -(-i) = i
  neg_sub (i j : I) : -(i - j) = j - i := by
    simp [sub_neg, add_comm, Int.neg_add]
  neg_add (i j : I) : -(i + j) = -i + -j
  zero_mul (i : I) : (0 : Int) * i = zero

  mul_distrib (n m : Int) (i : I) : (n + m) * i = n * i + m * i
  neg_mul (i : I) (n : Int) : (-n) * i = -(n * i)

  smul_zero (p : P) : zero • p = p
  smul_assoc (p : P) (i j : I) : j • (i • p) = (i + j) • p
  smul_div (p q : P) : (q / p) • p = q
  div_smul_self (i : I) (p : P) : (i • p) / p = i


class Scale (P I : Type) extends PseudoScale P, Torsor P I where
  fundamental : I
  pitches : List P


variable { P I }


def pitchCong [scale : Scale P I] (φ : I) (p q : P) :=
  ∃ (n : Int), p = (n * φ) • q


theorem pitchCong_equivalence [scale : Scale P I] (φ : I) : Equivalence (@pitchCong (P := P) (I := I) scale φ) :=
  {
    refl p := by
      unfold pitchCong
      apply Exists.intro 0
      simp [scale.zero_mul, scale.smul_zero]
    ,
    symm hcong := by
      unfold pitchCong at *
      rcases hcong with ⟨n, h⟩
      apply Exists.intro (-n)
      simp [h, scale.neg_mul, scale.smul_assoc, scale.add_right_neg, scale.smul_zero]
    ,
    trans hpqc hqrc := by
      unfold pitchCong at *
      rcases hpqc with ⟨npq, hpq⟩
      rcases hqrc with ⟨nqr, hqr⟩
      apply Exists.intro (npq + nqr)
      rewrite [hpq, hqr]
      simp [scale.mul_distrib, scale.smul_assoc, scale.add_comm]
    ,
  }


@[reducible]
def pitchSetoid [scale : Scale P I] (φ : I := scale.fundamental) : Setoid P := {
    r := pitchCong φ
    iseqv := pitchCong_equivalence φ
  }


abbrev pitchClass [scale : Scale P I] (φ : I := scale.fundamental)

private def nameDistanceAux (total : Nat) (key : Fin 7) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => total
  | remainder+1 =>
    nameDistanceAux (total + spaces[key]) (key + (1 : Fin 7)) remainder

private theorem nameDistanceAux_total (t1 t2 : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (a : Nat)
  : t1 + (nameDistanceAux t2 key a) = nameDistanceAux (t1 + t2) key a := by
  induction a generalizing t1 t2 key
  case zero =>
    rfl
  unfold nameDistanceAux
  rename_i this
  simp
  rewrite [this]
  rewrite [Nat.add_assoc]
  rfl

private theorem nameDistanceAux_next (total : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (n : Nat)
  : nameDistanceAux total key (n + 1) = (nameDistanceAux total (key + 1) n) + spaces[key]
  := by
  unfold nameDistanceAux
  split
  . unfold nameDistanceAux
    rfl
  conv =>
    lhs
    unfold nameDistanceAux
  conv =>
    rhs
    apply Nat.add_comm
  rewrite [nameDistanceAux_total spaces[key]]
  congr 1
  omega

private theorem nameDistanceAux_image (total : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (n m : Nat)
  : nameDistanceAux total key (n + m) = nameDistanceAux 0 key n + nameDistanceAux total (key + (Fin.ofNat 7 n)) m := by
  induction n generalizing total key m
  case zero =>
    simp
    unfold nameDistanceAux
    simp
  case succ n hi =>
    rewrite [Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.add_assoc]
    repeat rewrite [nameDistanceAux_next]
    rewrite [Nat.add_comm m _]
    rw [Fin.add_ofNat]
    rw [hi]
    rw [Fin.add_ofNat]
    simp
    simp [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
    congr 1
    refine Eq.symm (Fin.eq_of_val_eq ?_)
    simp
    refine Nat.add_mod_eq_add_mod_left n ?_
    grind

def nameDistance (n2 n1 : Int) : Int :=
  if n1 ≤ n2 then
    let fin : Fin 7 := Fin.intCast n1
    nameDistanceAux 0 fin (Int.toNat (n2 - n1))
  else
    let fin : Fin 7 := Fin.intCast n2
    let d : Int := nameDistanceAux 0 fin (Int.toNat (n1 - n2))
    (-d : Int)

private theorem intCast_key (a b : Int) (h : b ≤ a) :
    Fin.intCast b + Fin.ofNat 7 ((a + -b).toNat) = (Fin.intCast a : Fin 7) := by grind [Fin.intCast]

private def A (a b : Int) : Nat := nameDistanceAux 0 (Fin.intCast a) (b - a).toNat

private theorem nd_eq (n2 n1 : Int) :
    nameDistance n2 n1 = if n1 ≤ n2 then (A n1 n2 : Int) else -(A n2 n1 : Int) := rfl

private theorem A_key (a b c : Int) (h1 : a ≤ b) (h2 : b ≤ c) : A a b + A b c = A a c := by
  unfold A
  have hsplit : (c - a).toNat = (b - a).toNat + (c - b).toNat := by omega
  rw [hsplit, nameDistanceAux_image]
  have := intCast_key b a h1
  rw [← Int.sub_eq_add_neg] at this
  rw [this]

name: Prismriver.Classical.pitch_interval_add_comm
statement: theorem pitch_interval_add_comm (i j : Interval) (p : Pitch) : i • (j • p) = j • (i • p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HSMul.hSMul instHSMulIntervalPitch
  simp only [Pitch.mk.injEq, Accidental.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  rw [Int.add_right_comm]
  have h1 : (p.name + i.name + j.name) = (p.name + j.name + i.name) := by omega
  rw [← h1]
  have hsI  := nameDistance_swap (p.name + i.name + j.name) (p.name + i.name)
  have hsI' := nameDistance_swap (p.name + i.name) p.name
  rw [hsI']
  simp
  rw [hsI]
  simp
  rw [nameDistance_swap (p.name + j.name) p.name]
  rw [nameDistance_swap (p.name + i.name + j.name) (p.name + j.name)]
  simp
  rw [Int.add_right_comm (p.acc.semitones + i.semitones + nameDistance p.name (p.name + i.name))
                     j.semitones
                     (nameDistance (p.name + i.name) (p.name + i.name + j.name))]
  rw [Int.add_assoc (p.acc.semitones + i.semitones)
                (nameDistance p.name (p.name + i.name))
                (nameDistance (p.name + i.name) (p.name + i.name + j.name))]
  rw [nameDistance_image p.name (p.name + i.name) (p.name + i.name + j.name)]
  rw [Int.add_comm (p.acc.semitones + i.semitones) (nameDistance p.name (p.name + i.name + j.name))]
  rw [Int.add_assoc (nameDistance p.name (p.name + i.name + j.name)) (p.acc.semitones + i.semitones) j.semitones]
  rw [Int.add_comm (p.acc.semitones + j.semitones) (nameDistance p.name (p.name + j.name))]
  rw [Int.add_assoc (nameDistance p.name (p.name + j.name)) (p.acc.semitones + j.semitones) i.semitones]
  rw [Int.add_comm (nameDistance p.name (p.name + j.name)) (p.acc.semitones + j.semitones + i.semitones)]
  rw [Int.add_assoc (p.acc.semitones + j.semitones + i.semitones) (nameDistance p.name (p.name + j.name)) (nameDistance (p.name + j.name) (p.name + i.name + j.name))]
  rw [nameDistance_image p.name (p.name + j.name) (p.name + i.name + j.name)]
  rw [Int.add_comm (nameDistance p.name (p.name + i.name + j.name)) (p.acc.semitones + i.semitones + j.semitones)]
  rw [Int.add_right_comm p.acc.semitones j.semitones i.semitones]

private theorem nameDistanceAux_total (t1 t2 : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (a : Nat)
  : t1 + (nameDistanceAux t2 key a) = nameDistanceAux (t1 + t2) key a := by
  induction a generalizing t1 t2 key
  case zero =>
    rfl
  unfold nameDistanceAux
  rename_i this
  simp
  rewrite [this]
  rewrite [Nat.add_assoc]
  rfl

private theorem nameDistanceAux_next (total : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (n : Nat)
  : nameDistanceAux total key (n + 1) = (nameDistanceAux total (key + 1) n) + spaces[key]
  := by
  unfold nameDistanceAux
  split
  . unfold nameDistanceAux
    rfl
  conv =>
    lhs
    unfold nameDistanceAux
  conv =>
    rhs
    apply Nat.add_comm
  rewrite [nameDistanceAux_total spaces[key]]
  congr 1
  omega

private theorem nameDistanceAux_image (total : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (n m : Nat)
  : nameDistanceAux total key (n + m) = nameDistanceAux 0 key n + nameDistanceAux total (key + (Fin.ofNat 7 n)) m := by
  induction n generalizing total key m
  case zero =>
    simp
    unfold nameDistanceAux
    simp
  case succ n hi =>
    rewrite [Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.add_assoc]
    repeat rewrite [nameDistanceAux_next]
    rewrite [Nat.add_comm m _]
    rw [Fin.add_ofNat]
    rw [hi]
    rw [Fin.add_ofNat]
    simp
    simp [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
    congr 1
    refine Eq.symm (Fin.eq_of_val_eq ?_)
    simp
    refine Nat.add_mod_eq_add_mod_left n ?_
    grind

theorem nameDistance_swap (i j : Int) : nameDistance i j = - (nameDistance j i) := by

    rw [Int.sub_eq_zero.mpr this]
    have : j = i := Eq.symm this
    rw [Int.sub_eq_zero.mpr this]
    rw [this]
    rfl
  . simp
  . simp
  . have : j < i := Int.lt_of_not_ge ‹¬ i ≤ j›
    have : j ≤ i := Int.le_of_lt this

private theorem nd_add (a b c : Int) (h1 : a ≤ b) (h2 : b ≤ c) :
    nameDistance c a = nameDistance b a + nameDistance c b := by
  have hac : a ≤ c := le_trans h1 h2
  unfold nameDistance
  rw [if_pos hac, if_pos h1, if_pos h2]
  have hs : (c - a).toNat = (b - a).toNat + (c - b).toNat := by omega
  have key := intCast_key b a h1

  dsimp only
  rw [hs, nameDistanceAux_image, key]
  push_cast
  rfl

  have s1 := nameDistance_swap i j
  have s2 := nameDistance_swap j k
  have s3 := nameDistance_swap i k
  rcases le_total i j with h1 | h1 <;> rcases le_total j k with h2 | h2 <;>
    rcases le_total i k with h3 | h3 <;>
  first
  | (have := nd_add i j k ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
  | (have := nd_add i k j ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
  | (have := nd_add j i k ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
  | (have := nd_add j k i ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
  | (have := nd_add k i j ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
  | (have := nd_add k j i ‹_› ‹_›; omega)

theorem nd_hv (n : Int) : ((Fin.intCast n : Fin 7) : ℕ) = (n % 7).toNat := by
  unfold Fin.intCast
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [Fin.ofNat]
    omega

    omega

  simp

  (if x % 7 = 0 then 0 else if x % 7 = 1 then 2 else if x % 7 = 2 then 4 else

theorem nd_step (n : Int) : ((spaces[(Fin.intCast n : Fin 7)] : Nat) : Int) = nd_g (n+1) - nd_g n := by
  have h := nd_hv n
  generalize (Fin.intCast n : Fin 7) = k at h ⊢
  rcases k with ⟨k, hk7⟩
  simp only at h
  interval_cases k
  · have h1 : n % 7 = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : (n+1) % 7 = 1 := by omega
    simp [spaces, nd_g, h1, h2]; omega
  · have h1 : n % 7 = 1 := by omega
    have h2 : (n+1) % 7 = 2 := by omega
    simp [spaces, nd_g, h1, h2]; omega
  · have h1 : n % 7 = 2 := by omega
    have h2 : (n+1) % 7 = 3 := by omega
    simp [spaces, nd_g, h1, h2]; omega
  · have h1 : n % 7 = 3 := by omega
    have h2 : (n+1) % 7 = 4 := by omega
    simp [spaces, nd_g, h1, h2]; omega
  · have h1 : n % 7 = 4 := by omega
    have h2 : (n+1) % 7 = 5 := by omega
    simp [spaces, nd_g, h1, h2]; omega
  · have h1 : n % 7 = 5 := by omega
    have h2 : (n+1) % 7 = 6 := by omega
    simp [spaces, nd_g, h1, h2]; omega
  · have h1 : n % 7 = 6 := by omega
    have h2 : (n+1) % 7 = 0 := by omega
    simp [spaces, nd_g, h1, h2]; omega

theorem nd_aux_eq (d : Nat) : ∀ (total : Nat) (n : Int),
    ((nameDistanceAux total (Fin.intCast n) d : Nat) : Int) = total + nd_g (n + d) - nd_g n := by
  induction d with
  | zero => intro total n; simp [nameDistanceAux]
  | succ d ih =>
    intro total n
    rw [nameDistanceAux, nd_hs, ih]
    push_cast
    rw [nd_step]
    have : n + 1 + (d : Int) = n + ((d : Int) + 1) := by omega
    rw [this]
    ring

    nameDistanceAux 0 fin (Int.toNat (n2 - n1))

    let d : Int := nameDistanceAux 0 fin (Int.toNat (n1 - n2))
    (-d : Int)

  split_ifs with h

    rw [nd_aux_eq]
    have : b + ((a - b).toNat : Int) = a := by omega
    rw [this]; simp
  · dsimp only
    rw [nd_aux_eq]
    have : a + ((b - a).toNat : Int) = b := by omega
    rw [this]; simp

  rw [nd_eq, nd_eq]; ring

theorem nameDistance_image (i j k : Int) : nameDistance i j + nameDistance j k = nameDistance i k := by
  rw [nd_eq, nd_eq, nd_eq]; ring

theorem rInterval_rInterval (i j : I) (p : P) : rInterval i (rInterval j p) = rInterval (i + j) p := by
  unfold rInterval
  rw [← Torsor.add_comm]
  rw [Torsor.smul_assoc]

theorem rInterval_srInterval (i j : I) (a p : P) : rInterval i (srInterval j a p) = srInterval (j - i) a p := by
  unfold rInterval srInterval
  rw [Torsor.smul_assoc]
  congr
  have h1 :-(p / a) - (j - i) = -(p / a) + -j + i := by
    have : j - i = j + -i := by rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [this]
    rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [Torsor.neg_add]
    rw [Torsor.neg_neg]
    rw [Torsor.add_assoc]
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : -(p / a) - j + i = -(p / a) + -j + i := by rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [h2]

theorem hSub_hAdd_Pitch (p a : P) (j : I) : (j • p) / a = (p / a) + j := by
  rw [← Torsor.smul_div (P := P) (I := I) (p := a) (q := p)]
  rw [Torsor.smul_assoc]
  rw [Torsor.div_smul_self]
  rw [Torsor.div_smul_self]

theorem srInterval_rInterval (i j : I) (a p : P) :
    srInterval i a (rInterval j p) = srInterval (i + j) a p := by
  unfold srInterval rInterval
  rw [hSub_hAdd_Pitch]
  have h1 : (-(p / a + j) - i) • a = (-(p / a) + -j + -i) • a  := by
    rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [Torsor.neg_add]
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : (-(p / a) - (i + j)) • a = (-(p / a) + -i + -j) • a := by
    rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [Torsor.neg_add]
    rw [Torsor.add_assoc]
  rw [h2]
  have h3 : -(p / a) + -j + -i = -(p / a) + -i + -j := by
    rw [Torsor.add_assoc (-(p / a)) (-j) (-i)]
    rw [Torsor.add_assoc (-(p / a)) (-i) (-j)]
    rw [Torsor.add_comm (-j) (-i)]
  rw [h3]

theorem srInterval_srInterval (i j : I) (p a : P) : srInterval i a (srInterval j a p) = rInterval (j - i) p := by
  unfold srInterval rInterval
  rw [Torsor.div_smul_self (-(p / a) - j) a]
  rw [Torsor.neg_sub]
  rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg j (-(p / a))]
  rw [Torsor.neg_neg]
  have h : j + (p / a) + -i = (p / a) + (j - i) := by
    rw [Torsor.add_comm j (p/a)]
    rw [Torsor.add_assoc]
    rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg j i]
  have h1 : (j + (p / a) - i) • a = ((p / a) + (j - i)) • a := by
    rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg (j + (p / a)) i]
    rw [h]
  rw [h1]
  rw [← Torsor.smul_assoc]
  rw [Torsor.smul_div]

theorem pitch_sub_add_pitch_sub (a b p : P) : (a / b) + (p / a) = p / b := by
  symm
  rw [← hSub_hAdd_Pitch a b (p / a)]
  rw [Torsor.smul_div]

theorem srInterval_change_center
    (j : I) (a b p : P) :
    srInterval j b p = srInterval ((a / b) + (a / b) + j) a p := by
    unfold srInterval
    symm
    have h1 : (-(p / a) - (a / b + a / b + j)) • a = (-(p / a) + -(a / b) + -(a / b) + -j) • a := by
      rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [Torsor.neg_add]
      rw [Torsor.neg_add (a / b) (a / b)]
      rw [← Torsor.add_assoc (-(p / a)) (-(a / b) + -(a / b)) (-j)]
      rw [← Torsor.add_assoc (-(p / a)) (-(a / b)) (-(a / b))]
    rw [h1]
    rw [← Torsor.smul_div (P := P) (I := I) (p := b) (q := a)]
    rw [Torsor.smul_assoc]
    rw [Torsor.smul_div]
    rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [Torsor.add_assoc]
    have h2 : a / b + (-(p / a) + -(a / b) + -(a / b) + -j) = -(p / a) + -(a / b) + -j := by
      rw [Torsor.add_comm]
      rw [Torsor.add_assoc ((-(p / a) + -(a / b)) + -(a / b)) (-j) (a / b)]
      rw [Torsor.add_comm (-j) (a / b)]
      rw [Torsor.add_assoc]
      rw [← Torsor.add_assoc (-(a / b)) (a / b) (-j)]
      rw [Torsor.add_left_neg (a / b)]
      rw [Torsor.add_comm (Torsor.zero P) (-j)]
      rw [Torsor.add_zero]
    rw [← Torsor.add_assoc (-(p / a) + -(a / b)) (-(a / b)) (-j)]
    rw [h2]
    have h3 : -(p / a) + -(a / b) = -(p / b) := by
      rw [← Torsor.neg_add (p / a) (a / b)]
      rw [Torsor.add_comm (p / a) (a / b)]
      rw [pitch_sub_add_pitch_sub a b p]
    rw [h3]

theorem srInterval_srInterval_general (i j : I) (a b p : P) :
  srInterval i a (srInterval j b p) = rInterval ((a / b) + (a / b) + (j - i)) p := by
  rw [srInterval_change_center j a b p]
  rw [srInterval_srInterval]
  unfold rInterval
  have :  (a / b + a / b + (j - i)) • p = (a / b + a / b + j + -i) • p := by
    rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [← Torsor.add_assoc (a / b + a / b) j (-i)]
  rw [this]
  rw [Torsor.sub_eq_add_neg]

  | .r i, .sr a j => .sr a (j - i)

  | .sr a i, .sr b j => .r ((a / b) + (a / b) + (j - i))

def nameDistance (n2 n1 : Int) : Int :=
  if n1 ≤ n2 then
    let fin : Fin 7 := Fin.intCast n1
    nameDistanceAux 0 fin (Int.toNat (n2 - n1))
  else
    let fin : Fin 7 := Fin.intCast n2
    let d : Int := nameDistanceAux 0 fin (Int.toNat (n1 - n2))
    (-d : Int)

private theorem intCast_key (a b : Int) (h : b ≤ a) :
    Fin.intCast b + Fin.ofNat 7 ((a - b).toNat) = (Fin.intCast a : Fin 7) := by
  rw [Int.sub_eq_add_neg]; grind [Fin.intCast]

private def D (a b : Int) : Int := (nameDistanceAux 0 (Fin.intCast a) (b - a).toNat : Nat)

private theorem D_add (a b c : Int) (h1 : a ≤ b) (h2 : b ≤ c) : D a c = D a b + D b c := by
  unfold D
  have h : (c - a).toNat = (b - a).toNat + (c - b).toNat := by omega
  rw [h, nameDistanceAux_image, intCast_key b a h1]
  push_cast
  rfl

private theorem D_self (a : Int) : D a a = 0 := by
  have := D_add a a a le_rfl le_rfl
  omega

private theorem nd_eq (x y : Int) : nameDistance x y = if y ≤ x then D y x else -D x y := by
  unfold nameDistance D
  split_ifs <;> rfl

theorem nameDistance_image (i j k : Int) : nameDistance i j + nameDistance j k = nameDistance i k := by
  rw [nd_eq, nd_eq, nd_eq]
  have F1 := D_add i j k
  have F2 := D_add i k j
  have F3 := D_add j i k
  have F4 := D_add j k i
  have F5 := D_add k i j
  have F6 := D_add k j i
  have := D_self i
  have := D_self j
  have := D_self k
  split_ifs <;> omega

  · show i.semitones + j.semitones + k.semitones = i.semitones + (j.semitones + k.semitones)

  · show i.semitones - (-j.semitones) = i.semitones + j.semitones

  apply Interval.ext

  · show -(j.semitones - i.semitones) = -j.semitones + i.semitones

        = p.acc.semitones + (i.semitones + j.semitones)
          - nameDistance (p.name + (i.name + j.name)) p.name

instance : Torsor Pitch Interval where
  zero := Interval.zero

    apply Interval.ext
    · show i.name + 0 = i.name

    · show i.semitones + 0 = i.semitones
      omega
  add_comm := Interval.add_comm
  add_left_neg := Interval.add_left_neg
  add_right_neg i := by
    rw [Interval.add_comm]
    apply Interval.add_left_neg
  add_assoc := Interval.add_assoc
  zero_mul i := by
    apply Interval.ext
    · show (0:Int) * i.name = 0
      omega
    · show (0:Int) * i.semitones = 0
      omega
  neg_sub i j := by
    rw [Interval.neg_neg_sub]
    rw [Interval.add_comm]
    rfl
  sub_neg i j := by
    rw [Interval.sub_neg]
  sub_eq_add_neg i j := by
    apply Interval.ext
    rfl
    rfl
  neg_neg i := by
    apply Interval.ext
    · show -(-i.name) = i.name
      omega
    · show -(-i.semitones) = i.semitones
      omega
  neg_add i := by
    intro j
    rw [Interval.neg_add]
  neg_mul x _n := by
    apply Interval.ext
    · show -_n * x.name = -(_n * x.name)
      exact Int.neg_mul _ _
    · show -_n * x.semitones = -(_n * x.semitones)
      exact Int.neg_mul _ _
  mul_distrib n m i := by
    apply Interval.ext
    · show (n + m) * i.name = n * i.name + m * i.name
      exact Int.add_mul _ _ _
    · show (n + m) * i.semitones = n * i.semitones + m * i.semitones
      exact Int.add_mul _ _ _
  smul_zero p := by
    apply Pitch.ext
    · show p.name + 0 = p.name
      omega
    · apply Accidental.ext
      show p.acc.semitones + 0 - nameDistance (p.name + 0) p.name = p.acc.semitones
      have := nameDistance_refl p.name
      simp only [Int.add_zero]
      omega
  smul_assoc p i j := pitch_interval_add_assoc i j p
  smul_div p q := by
    have h : p.name + (q.name - p.name) = q.name := by omega
    apply Pitch.ext
    · exact h
    · apply Accidental.ext
      show p.acc.semitones + (nameDistance q.name p.name + (q.acc.semitones - p.acc.semitones))
          - nameDistance (p.name + (q.name - p.name)) p.name = q.acc.semitones
      rw [h]
      omega
  div_smul_self i p := by
    apply Interval.ext
    · show p.name + i.name - p.name = i.name
      omega
    · show nameDistance (p.name + i.name) p.name
          + (p.acc.semitones + i.semitones - nameDistance (p.name + i.name) p.name - p.acc.semitones)

      omega

class Torsor (P I : Type) extends Add I, Sub I, HMul Int I I, Neg I, HSMul I P P, HDiv P P I where
  zero : I
  add_zero (i : I) : i + zero = i
  add_comm (i j : I) : i + j = j + i
  add_assoc (i j k : I) : (i + j) + k = i + (j + k)
  add_left_neg (i : I) : (-i) + i = zero
  add_right_neg (i : I) : i + (-i) = zero := by
    rw [add_comm]
  sub_neg (i j : I) : i - (-j) = i + j
  sub_eq_add_neg (i j : I) : i - j = i + -j
  neg_neg (i : I) : -(-i) = i
  neg_sub (i j : I) : -(i - j) = j - i := by
    simp [sub_neg, add_comm, Int.neg_add]
  neg_add (i j : I) : -(i + j) = -i + -j
  zero_mul (i : I) : (0 : Int) * i = zero

  mul_distrib (n m : Int) (i : I) : (n + m) * i = n * i + m * i
  neg_mul (i : I) (n : Int) : (-n) * i = -(n * i)

  smul_zero (p : P) : zero • p = p
  smul_assoc (p : P) (i j : I) : j • (i • p) = (i + j) • p
  smul_div (p q : P) : (q / p) • p = q
  div_smul_self (i : I) (p : P) : (i • p) / p = i

def pitchCong [scale : Scale P I] (φ : I) (p q : P) :=
  ∃ (n : Int), p = (n * φ) • q

theorem pitchCong_equivalence [scale : Scale P I] (φ : I) : Equivalence (@pitchCong (P := P) (I := I) scale φ) :=
  {
    refl p := by
      unfold pitchCong
      apply Exists.intro 0
      simp [scale.zero_mul, scale.smul_zero]
    ,
    symm hcong := by
      unfold pitchCong at *
      rcases hcong with ⟨n, h⟩
      apply Exists.intro (-n)
      simp [h, scale.neg_mul, scale.smul_assoc, scale.add_right_neg, scale.smul_zero]
    ,
    trans hpqc hqrc := by
      unfold pitchCong at *
      rcases hpqc with ⟨npq, hpq⟩
      rcases hqrc with ⟨nqr, hqr⟩
      apply Exists.intro (npq + nqr)
      rewrite [hpq, hqr]
      simp [scale.mul_distrib, scale.smul_assoc, scale.add_comm]
    ,
  }

private def nameDistanceAux (total : Nat) (key : Fin 7) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => total
  | remainder+1 =>
    nameDistanceAux (total + spaces[key]) (key + (1 : Fin 7)) remainder

private theorem nameDistanceAux_total (t1 t2 : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (a : Nat)
  : t1 + (nameDistanceAux t2 key a) = nameDistanceAux (t1 + t2) key a := by
  induction a generalizing t1 t2 key
  case zero =>
    rfl
  unfold nameDistanceAux
  rename_i this
  simp
  rewrite [this]
  rewrite [Nat.add_assoc]
  rfl

private theorem nameDistanceAux_next (total : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (n : Nat)
  : nameDistanceAux total key (n + 1) = (nameDistanceAux total (key + 1) n) + spaces[key]
  := by
  unfold nameDistanceAux
  split
  . unfold nameDistanceAux
    rfl
  conv =>
    lhs
    unfold nameDistanceAux
  conv =>
    rhs
    apply Nat.add_comm
  rewrite [nameDistanceAux_total spaces[key]]
  congr 1
  omega

private theorem nameDistanceAux_image (total : Nat) (key : Fin 7) (n m : Nat)
  : nameDistanceAux total key (n + m) = nameDistanceAux 0 key n + nameDistanceAux total (key + (Fin.ofNat 7 n)) m := by
  induction n generalizing total key m with
  | zero => simp [nameDistanceAux]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : Fin.ofNat 7 (n+1) = Fin.ofNat 7 n + 1 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      show (n+1) % 7 = (n % 7 + 1) % 7
      exact (Nat.mod_add_mod n 7 1).symm
    have hk : key + Fin.ofNat 7 (n+1) = (key + 1) + Fin.ofNat 7 n := by
      rw [h1, ← add_assoc, add_right_comm]
    rw [hk, show n + 1 + m = (n + m) + 1 by omega, nameDistanceAux_next, nameDistanceAux_next 0 key n,
      ih total (key + 1) m]
    omega

def nameDistance (n2 n1 : Int) : Int :=
  if n1 ≤ n2 then
    let fin : Fin 7 := Fin.intCast n1
    nameDistanceAux 0 fin (Int.toNat (n2 - n1))
  else
    let fin : Fin 7 := Fin.intCast n2
    let d : Int := nameDistanceAux 0 fin (Int.toNat (n1 - n2))
    (-d : Int)

private theorem intCast_key (a b : Int) (h : b ≤ a) :
    Fin.intCast b + Fin.ofNat 7 ((a + -b).toNat) = (Fin.intCast a : Fin 7) := by grind [Fin.intCast]

private def ndA (a b : Int) : Int := ((nameDistanceAux 0 (Fin.intCast a) (b - a).toNat : Nat) : Int)

private theorem nd_le (a b : Int) (h : a ≤ b) : nameDistance a b = -ndA a b := by
  by_cases hb : b ≤ a
  · have : a = b := Int.le_antisymm h hb
    subst this
    simp [nameDistance, ndA, nameDistanceAux]
  · simp [nameDistance, ndA, hb]

private theorem nd_ge (a b : Int) (h : b ≤ a) : nameDistance a b = ndA b a := by
  simp [nameDistance, ndA, h]

private theorem ndA_tri (a b c : Int) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    ndA a c = ndA a b + ndA b c := by
  unfold ndA
  have hs : (c - a).toNat = (b - a).toNat + (c - b).toNat := by omega
  have hk : Fin.intCast a + Fin.ofNat 7 (b - a).toNat = (Fin.intCast b : Fin 7) := by
    rw [Int.sub_eq_add_neg]; exact intCast_key b a hab
  rw [hs, nameDistanceAux_image, hk, Nat.cast_add]

theorem nameDistance_refl (i : Int) : nameDistance i i = 0 := by
  simp [nameDistance, nameDistanceAux]

theorem nameDistance_swap (i j : Int) : nameDistance i j = - (nameDistance j i) := by
  rcases le_total i j with h | h
  · simp [nd_le i j h, nd_ge j i h]
  · simp [nd_ge i j h, nd_le j i h]

theorem nameDistance_image (i j k : Int) : nameDistance i j + nameDistance j k = nameDistance i k := by
  rcases le_total i j with h1 | h1 <;> rcases le_total j k with h2 | h2 <;> rcases le_total i k with h3 | h3
  all_goals first
    | (have e1 : i = j := by omega
       have e2 : j = k := by omega
       subst e1; subst e2; simp [nameDistance, nameDistanceAux])
    | (first | rw [nd_le i j h1] | rw [nd_ge i j h1]
       first | rw [nd_le j k h2] | rw [nd_ge j k h2]
       first | rw [nd_le i k h3] | rw [nd_ge i k h3]
       first
         | (have := ndA_tri i j k ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
         | (have := ndA_tri i k j ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
         | (have := ndA_tri j i k ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
         | (have := ndA_tri j k i ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
         | (have := ndA_tri k i j ‹_› ‹_›; omega)
         | (have := ndA_tri k j i ‹_› ‹_›; omega))

      @TransposeAction Pitch Interval → DihedralGroup 12
    | .r i =>
        DihedralGroup.r (interval_toZMod12 i)
    | .sr a i =>
        DihedralGroup.sr (interval_toZMod12 i - 2 * pitch_toZMod12 a)

def transposeTriad (n : ZMod 12) (t : Triad) : Triad :=
  (t.1 + n, t.2)

def invertTriad (n : ZMod 12) (t : Triad) : Triad :=
    (-t.1 + n, t.2.flip)

  smul g t :=
    match g with
    | DihedralGroup.r n =>
        transposeTriad n t
    | DihedralGroup.sr n =>
        invertTriad (-n) t

lemma pitch_toZMod12_smul_interval (p : Pitch) (i : Interval) :
  pitch_toZMod12 (i • p) = pitch_toZMod12 p + interval_toZMod12 i := by
  unfold pitch_toZMod12 interval_toZMod12
  simp only [smul_Pitch_Interval_acc, smul_Pitch_Interval_name]
  rw [← nameDistance_image (p.name + i.name) p.name 0]
  grind

lemma pitch_toZMod12_smul_neg_interval (p : Pitch) (i : Interval) :
    pitch_toZMod12 ((-i) • p) =
      pitch_toZMod12 p - interval_toZMod12 i := by
  rw [pitch_toZMod12_smul_interval]
  have : interval_toZMod12 (-i) = - interval_toZMod12 i := by
    unfold interval_toZMod12
    exact Int.cast_neg _
  rw [this, sub_eq_add_neg]

lemma interval_toZMod12_pitch_sub_pitch (p q : Pitch) :
    interval_toZMod12 (p / q) =
      pitch_toZMod12 p - pitch_toZMod12 q := by
  unfold pitch_toZMod12 interval_toZMod12
  simp only [div_Pitch_Pitch_semitones, Accidental.sub_Accidental_semitones]
  rw [← nameDistance_image p.name q.name 0]

lemma pitch_toZMod12_srInterval (a p : Pitch) (i : Interval) :
    pitch_toZMod12 (srInterval i a p) = 2 * pitch_toZMod12 a - pitch_toZMod12 p - interval_toZMod12 i := by
  have e : srInterval i a p = (-((p / a) + i)) • a := by
    unfold srInterval
    have h : (-(p / a) - i : Interval) = -((p / a) + i) :=
      Interval.ext (by show -(p / a).name - i.name = -((p / a).name + i.name); omega)
        (by show -(p / a).semitones - i.semitones = -((p / a).semitones + i.semitones); omega)
    exact congrArg (fun x => x • a) h
  rw [e]
  rw [pitch_toZMod12_smul_neg_interval a ((p / a) + i)]
  have h2 : interval_toZMod12 ((p / a) + i) = interval_toZMod12 (p / a) + interval_toZMod12 i := by
    unfold interval_toZMod12
    show (((p / a).semitones + i.semitones : Int) : ZMod 12) = _
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [h2]
  rw [interval_toZMod12_pitch_sub_pitch]
  ring

  zero : I

  add_comm (i j : I) : i + j = j + i
  add_assoc (i j k : I) : (i + j) + k = i + (j + k)

  add_right_neg (i : I) : i + (-i) = zero := by

  sub_neg (i j : I) : i - (-j) = i + j
  sub_eq_add_neg (i j : I) : i - j = i + -j
  neg_neg (i : I) : -(-i) = i

    simp [sub_neg, add_comm, Int.neg_add]

  smul_zero (p : P) : zero • p = p

  smul_div (p q : P) : (q / p) • p = q
